text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, Seiun Sky doesn't show up for
training. I
wander around the campus,
hoping to spot her.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Snooze...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I find her on the roof, sleeping in an
outfit that
looks somewhat out of place
there.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Yeah, this is what I wore to the Droite.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Don't look at me like that. This outfit is
pretty
flexible, and it breathes well,
believe it or not.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
It fits like my tracksuit, which means I
can use it
as pajamas.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Now that's the real tragedy. I'd been
putting off my laundry for a while, and
then, one right after the other, all the
laundry machines in the dorm went
kaput!
choice_data_list: First of all, why would that make ...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
And then! El and Grass dragged me into
a game
of tag, and I got my uniform all
dirty.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I don't have any other comfy clothes,
so...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: This is my chance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She brings me dashing down the stairs
and bursts into an empty classroom on
the second floor
where she pulls me to a
window.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Keep quiet... Do you see her?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I follow Sky's gaze to see a kitten
clutching
desperately to a tree branch in
reach of the
second floor.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I've tried to grab her a bunch of times,
but my
arms aren't quite long enough.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We take turns reaching for the cat, but
it's just
out of reach. So we put our
heads together to try
and—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Whooooshhh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A powerful wind blows, knocking the
kitten off balance. It hangs on, clutching
the bark with its
claws. At any moment,
it could fall...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Got it! Don't drop me!
choice_data_list: I'll support you, so reach out you...
Quick, let's head down to the firs...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She reaches out the window with hands 
outstretched. Her fingers are millimeters
away
when the kitten loses its grip and
falls!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At that very instant, Sky kicks off from
the
windowsill and soars into the air!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She catches the little kitty in midair and
holds it close to her chest as she lands
on the ground with
an impressive roll,
lessening the impact.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: There, there. You feeling okay, kitty?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
That was scary, huh? You must've been
so
surprised, nya-ha-ha.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Oh, Trainer. You look pretty confused.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oh please, anyone could do that when push
comes to shove. Doesn't hurt that
these clothes
are so easy to move
around in, though!
choice_data_list: I had no idea you could move so ni...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Still, keep this to yourself. I don't want
anyone
else to know.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She raises a finger to her lips, looking a
bit
embarrassed.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Got it—be there in a jiff.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The moment those words leave her lips,
Sky steps
up onto the windowsill.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Here... goes... nothing!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She swiftly leaps into the air and, like a
parkour artist, hops and skips down the
windowsills and
rain pipe. In just seconds
she's on the ground.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Okay! Come here, kitty!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Oh... Well, the stairs would've
taken too
long.
choice_data_list: You could do something like that!?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
And I've been practicing taking
shortcuts
whenever I find the time.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
But that's not what's important right
now! We
have a cat to save! Here, kitty!
You can jump—I
promise I'll catch ya.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few seconds later, the kitten falls from
the tree
and into Sky's hands.
Thankfully, it's unhurt.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
What a relief... Sweetie, promise me you
won't go
climbing up so high anymore,
okay?

text_block_list.name: Kitten
text_block_list.text: Meow.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
What's this, did you understand me?
You're such
a cutie. Mew mew mew!
